name: B24
description: Backed by a Schwab brokerage account.
methodology: NAV uses the finalized reserve valuation and circulating supply recorded on Post Fiat. Verification coverage is taken from each packet; finalization alone does not prove the reserves. The brokerage reading is attested; a separate native subscription reserve is reported.
